mutations.name: BA-LEAKTAG
mutations._mechanism: the control tag rides along in every payload row: the readers are no longer blind

mutations.name: BA-KEEPID
mutations._mechanism: 'id' drops out of the reserved set: --keep id ships the original id, which can name its lane or its tag

mutations.name: BA-ITEMCOLLIDE
mutations._mechanism: 'item' drops out of the reserved set: a corpus 'item' field overwrites the assigned item id

mutations.name: BA-ALLOWBYPASS
mutations._mechanism: the allowlist reverts to a denylist: an unlisted 'label' field rides into the payload
mutations.find: row.update({k: by_id[oid][k] for k in keep})
mutations.replace: row.update({k: v for k, v in by_id[oid].items() if k not in ("id", "tag")})

mutations.name: BA-NOKEEPOK
mutations._mechanism: build with no --keep proceeds instead of refusing

mutations.name: BA-SCHEMAGAP
mutations._mechanism: a selected row lacking a kept field is not refused with a named reason

mutations.name: BA-DUPLAST
mutations._mechanism: a duplicate corpus id silently last-wins instead of refusing

mutations.name: BA-NEGVALID
mutations._mechanism: a negative control called upheld no longer fails the set: VALID despite an over-calling reader

mutations.name: BA-MISSREJECT
mutations._mechanism: a key item the reader skipped is scored as rejected instead of failing closed

mutations.name: BA-CONTROLSTOTAL
mutations._mechanism: a key with zero positive or zero negative controls scores VALID: 0/0 counts as all recovered

mutations.name: BA-MALFORMEDKEY
mutations._mechanism: the key is not validated before indexing: a malformed key tracebacks with no ADJUDICATION token
